steps.description: Check if any installed plugins are deprecated.
steps.resolution: Check the documentation for recommended steps or delete the plugin.
steps.title: Deprecation check

steps.description: Checks if an installed plugins has a newer version available.
steps.resolution: There are newer versions available for the plugins listed below. We recommend going to the plugin admin page and upgrading to the latest version.
steps.title: Update check

steps.description: Checks if the plugin's signature is missing or invalid.
steps.resolution: For security, we recommend only installing plugins from the catalog. Review the plugin's status and verify your allowlist if appropriate.
steps.title: Plugin signature check

steps.description: Warns when the Grafana IoT TwinMaker App is installed that the SceneViewer panel will stop working in Grafana 13.1.
steps.resolution: The SceneViewer panel in the TwinMaker App will stop working in Grafana 13.1. Ignore or silence this warning if you are not using the SceneViewer panel.
steps.title: TwinMaker SceneViewer deprecation check
